This folder should contain vendored frontend bundles so the app can run offline.

Required files (place exact filenames here):

- chart.umd.min.js (Chart.js v4.x)
- html2canvas.min.js (html2canvas v1.4.1)
- jspdf.umd.min.js (jsPDF v2.5.1 UMD build)
- jquery-3.7.1.min.js (jQuery v3.7.1)
- datatables.min.js (DataTables bundle if used)
- sweetalert2.min.js (SweetAlert2)

How to populate:

1. Download the listed files from their official CDNs and place them here.
2. Confirm frontend script tags reference `../vendor/<filename>`.

If you want me to write these files into the repo, reply and I'll add them (I can fetch the minified bundles and write them here).
